description: Defines the WebSocketHandshakeStreamBase class, including its nested CreateHelper class, enums for handshake results, and related static methods and members. It serves as a base class for WebSocket handshake streams in the Chromium networking code.

classes.name: WebSocketHandshakeStreamBase
classes.description: Base class for WebSocket handshake streams, providing enums for handshake results, factory methods for creating streams over different protocols, and validation utilities.

classes.name: WebSocketHandshakeStreamBase::CreateHelper
classes.description: Helper class for creating WebSocket handshake streams, used per connection, supporting creation of basic, HTTP/2, and HTTP/3 streams.

methods.name: Upgrade
methods.description: Creates a WebSocketStream from the handshake stream after handshake completion.

methods.name: CanReadFromStream
methods.description: Indicates if reading from the stream will succeed, even at EOF.

methods.name: MultipleHeaderValuesMessage
methods.description: Generates a message for multiple header values.

methods.name: GetWeakPtr
methods.description: Returns a weak pointer to the WebSocketHandshakeStreamBase instance.

methods.name: AddVectorHeaderIfNonEmpty
methods.description: Adds a header with multiple values if the vector is non-empty.

methods.name: ValidateSubProtocol
methods.description: Validates the Sec-WebSocket-Protocol header against requested protocols.

methods.name: RecordHandshakeResult
methods.description: Records the result of the handshake attempt.
